breaking.change: The <hud> control's frame shadow is now --hud-frame-shadow. --hud-shadow is only the HUD text shadow the built-in components set their text with; the two shared one name, so a pack that set it for the frame gave that text an invalid text-shadow, and the default frame drew the text shadow.
breaking.fix: In a style pack, rename --hud-shadow to --hud-frame-shadow where it styles hud::part(frame); keep --hud-shadow only for a text shadow.

fixed.summary: The compass, nameplates and other HUD text take a valid text shadow under the cartoon pack, and the compass caret draws as its triangle.
